overview: Enterprise AI adoption expands as Uber rolls out ChatGPT Work to 30,000 staff
OpenAI launches Decisions API for faster, cheaper structured AI decisions
OpenAI pursues $30 billion funding round valuing it over $1 trillion

top.title: Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI
top.summary: Uber deployed ChatGPT Work company‑wide, giving 30,000 employees access to an agent that integrates with Google and Slack tools, leveraging OpenAI’s latest models for multi‑step knowledge work.

top.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
top.summary: OpenAI made the Decisions API generally available, offering GPT‑6 Luna‑based rapid decision‑making on text, images, and JSON, with lower latency, higher throughput, and new answer types.

top.title: Beyond tree cover: mapping the world’s forest types
top.summary: DeepMind released a global 10‑meter resolution map that classifies every land patch into specific forest types, improving ecological monitoring and climate research.

top.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
top.summary: Reports say OpenAI is negotiating a private raise of up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre‑money valuation, potentially surpassing $1 trillion and influencing upcoming IPO plans.

top.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
top.summary: OpenAI opened its Decisions API model to all users, positioning it against fast, low‑cost decision models like TypeSafe’s Jev, with latency reduced to sub‑200 ms.

top.title: Discord now formats Markdown previews right
top.summary: Discord updated its client to render Markdown files correctly, aiding readability of AI‑related documentation and improving file‑sharing workflows for users.
